title: How To Whack | Lorena Valenzuela | Beginner Whacking Tutorial

method.teacher_system: Lorena breaks down waacking fundamentals step-by-step, focusing first on arm lines and overhead movements. She demonstrates each movement slowly, drills them on one side then the other, and combines them into sequences before speeding up.
method.signature: She emphasizes the sharp striking and posing characteristic of waacking, making sure students reach all the way back to touch their shoulders.

practices.what: Teaches the basic arm lines and overhead movements, starting with the right arm going down, back, and overhead.
Repeats the same arm line sequence on the other side.
Combines both arms together into the sequence.
Adds diagonal arm movements and overhead combinations.
Practices the entire sequence together at a faster pace with counts.
Demonstrates how to freestyle and mix arm lines and overheads in any direction.

adaptations.difficulty: The routine feels a little hard and fast.
adaptations.adjustment: Reminds learners that everything is about practice and to take it step by step.

beliefs.belief: Everything is about practice; with repetition, you can master any difficult movement.

feelings.response: Acknowledges that it feels like a lot, then suggests going right back to the beginning to break it down.

struggles.theme: Arms burning or hitting face while waacking
Hard to keep up once the speed increases

clicked.theme: Explained so clearly and easy to follow

meant.theme: Great arm workout and fun first waacking experience

method.limits: The video is an outdoor tutorial without mirror-flipped views or music during the breakdown phase.
